#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

class Reader {
    static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 16;
    FILE* din;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int bufferPointer, bytesRead;
    
public:
    Reader() {
        din = stdin;
        bufferPointer = bytesRead = 0;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int ret = 0;
        char c = read();
        while (c <= ' ') c = read();
        bool neg = (c == '-');
        if (neg) c = read();
        do {
            ret = ret * 10 + c - '0';
        } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9');
        if (neg) return -ret;
        return ret;
    }
    
private:
    void fillBuffer() {
        bytesRead = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, din);
        bufferPointer = 0;
        if (bytesRead == 0) buffer[0] = -1;
    }
    
    char read() {
        if (bufferPointer >= bytesRead) fillBuffer();
        if (buffer[bufferPointer] == -1) return -1;
        return buffer[bufferPointer++];
    }
};

class Print {
    FILE* out;
public:
    Print() {
        out = stdout;
    }
    
    void printLine(const char* str) {
        fputs(str, out);
        fputc('\n', out);
    }
    
    void printLine(const string& str) {
        fputs(str.c_str(), out);
        fputc('\n', out);
    }
};

int main() {
    Reader sc;
    Print pr;
    int t = 1;
    while (t--) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int a[3], b[3];
        a[0] = sc.nextInt(); // a1
        a[2] = sc.nextInt(); // a3
        a[1] = sc.nextInt(); // a2
        b[0] = sc.nextInt(); // b1
        b[2] = sc.nextInt(); // b3
        b[1] = sc.nextInt(); // b2
        int min = 0, max = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            max += min(a[i], b[(i + 2) % 3]);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            min += max(0, a[i] - (b[(i + 1) % 3] + b[i]));
        }
        char buf[50];
        sprintf(buf, "%d %d", min, max);
        pr.printLine(buf);
    }
    return 0;
}
